integrity: All supplied rank decisions are integer polynomial reductions modulo the primitive twelfth cyclotomic polynomial; finite-field corroboration alone is not accepted as proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite order-twelve classification with complete exact cyclotomic certificate; no result for larger orders, numerical stability, or previously unindexed tables. Aggregate zero-minor counts and full-spark row classification are credited as prior work.
title: Complete fifth-order Fourier rank incidence on the twelve-cycle
